name: flux-count
description: Counts Flux records per value of one field -- uniq -c for records.
notes:
Groups Flux records by the value of one field and counts them -- sort | uniq -c | sort -rn for records. One tally record per value, largest count first; the value is carried under the grouped field's own name; records without the field are counted under null and reported on stderr.

Prototype for #59 (2026-10-13); promoted to Rust in #78 (2026-10-14), with the Python version kept as the diff-test reference. Emits tally:observed, not count:observed -- flux-wc already uses count:observed with other fields. Accumulates its input. Pair of flux-sort (#58).
